title: Aerogel Technologies LLC
content: Aerogel Technologies LLC is a U.S. specialty company focused on custom aerogel materials, formulation development, and small-batch supply for research and industrial programs. Its portfolio includes silica aerogels, carbon aerogels, and related custom materials used in laboratory testing, prototyping, and specialty applications. The company is relevant to the Equipment Materials category as a source of development-stage aerogel materials and technical support for R&D-driven projects.
